Worst experience!

Well there is a 10% discount promotion going on if you give them a good review. This is an honest and unbiased review. The foods definitely have its own style and flavour which are very tasty no doubt. However, the staff's attitude is disgraceful. I'm talking about the waiter and waitress at night time when we ate, not the people in the kitchen which is surprisingly friendly. Their behaviour will give you a sense of as if you come to this restaurant to beg for foods. Such a shame that customers will not visit the restaurant again not due to the foods, but the staff of the restaurant

Modern Hong Kong food
Dec 2019 • Couples
A local hidden gem! This is a fusion modern Hong Kong style restaurant specialized in Cha Siu. We ordered their Happy Meal set, comes with Cha Siu, crispy skin chicken, deep fried pork rind, home-made mantou, two pickled veggies and two drinks. The set not only look great and taste fantastic. Highly recommend if you are looking for quality food. The restaurant itself is also very photogenic.
